Messages.Author: agen...@my-dejanews.com
Messages.Body:
Damage from allies that do not specify it as Hand Damage, is
it hand damage? Like if a Hell Hound was in combat, does it
do 'Hand Damage'?
The reason I ask is because of Immortal Grapple. Please resolve
the following scenarios:

Order of Hermes Cabal (1R agg) is Immortally Grappled.
I say Order of Hermes Cabal has no available strike
Am I correct?

Renegade Garou (2 damage) is Immortally Grappled.
I say that Renegade Garou does the 2 damage to it's opponent.
Am I correct?

Succubus (1 aggravated damage) is Immortally Grappled
I say that she does 1 agg damage to it's opponent.
Am I correct?

Thanks for the clarification.

a0

Messages.Author: Derek S. Ray
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 01 Mar 1999 01:12:55 GMT, agen...@my-dejanews.com wrote:

>Damage from allies that do not specify it as Hand Damage, is
>it hand damage? Like if a Hell Hound was in combat, does it
>do 'Hand Damage'?
>The reason I ask is because of Immortal Grapple. Please resolve
>the following scenarios:
>
>Order of Hermes Cabal (1R agg) is Immortally Grappled.
>I say Order of Hermes Cabal has no available strike
>Am I correct?
>
>Renegade Garou (2 damage) is Immortally Grappled.
>I say that Renegade Garou does the 2 damage to it's opponent.
>Am I correct?
>
>Succubus (1 aggravated damage) is Immortally Grappled
>I say that she does 1 agg damage to it's opponent.
>Am I correct?

IANALSJ, but these are all correct. Hand damage can be aggravated or
normal, so aggravated in itself does not naturally rule out the use of
hand damage. Hands can NEVER do damage at range though, so the Order
of Hermes obviously is not using their hands for 1R agg - so they must
strike-hands for zero hand damage.

...which means that Muddles bops you on the nose for four hand damage
with First Strike, making him largely immune to weenie potence Rush.
:) (OK, i like the card. sue me. ;)

-- Derek

Correct (with the correction to Order of Hermes you cite).

* Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based
on the striking minion's hand damage, or any minion's non-ranged
damage-dealing innate strike. [LSJ 970224]
